The Meal That Used the Whole Harvest

用完一筐收成的一餐 · 649 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A school cafeteria received a mixed harvest from a farm. The cook, Malik, had ordered potatoes and a staple grain. The delivery also held zucchini, eggplant, celery, and several ripe peaches. The farmer said a restaurant had refused the produce because it was too small. Malik wanted a healthful menu that pupils could recognize. His assistant suggested grinding everything into a sauce. Malik asked her to taste one piece from each basket. The meal could use more of the harvest if every ingredient had a clear purpose.

2They chose stew. Malik used a processor for celery, then chopped the eggplant by hand. Olive oil and salt let it brown before the zucchini went in. The mixture simmered slowly and kept a tender texture. A little mustard added flavor without masking the vegetables. Pupils had expected a plain salad. They saw how a cook could concentrate the flavor in a sauce and use leaves, stems, and flesh that would otherwise go in the garbage.

3The grain was a separate problem. A bowl of cereal often sat untouched. One pupil said it became sticky, another wanted more fruit. Malik boiled a small batch with coconut, then mixed peach into one serving. He let the rest cool, used a brush to coat it with oil, and reheated it as cakes. A spoonful of vanilla yoghurt gave it a different taste. A pupil said she would eat it with a mango slice or a grape, depending on what arrived.

4A worker proposed lamb or seafood. Malik kept the base vegetarian. He used another pan for shrimp and a separate tray for salmon. A pupil asked whether a leftover steak could go into the same gravy. The school nurse explained that a label had to state what was in each part, not just the calorie count. The menu could include pasta, a curry, or a mushroom dish in winter. Clear preparation and storage mattered whichever topping they used.

5At lunchtime the stew ran out first. The pupils asked if the school could repeat it in winter. Malik asked the farm which crops were plentiful then. A grower offered cabbage, a small supply of broccoli, and a jar of homemade tomato sauce. He could cultivate another crop if the school promised a regular order. Malik preferred to begin with a flexible plan. A different vegetable could play the same part as the eggplant without making the dish depend on a distant shipment.

6Another class asked how the kitchen could substitute a vegetable after a delivery failed. Malik made a small cauliflower dish with basil. A pupil used a whisk to whip a topping, then tasted the mixture before adding more salt. It was too bitter for the young children. They tried a mild version in a dumpling. The cook used the test to plan how to nourish the group without requiring everyone to choose the same dish.

7Two baskets of peaches remained. The cooks used some in a dessert and chilled the rest to serve with yoghurt. A pupil wanted to turn the skins into a decoration. Malik showed her why a mouldy or dirty piece had to go. The school's aim was healthier consumption with less waste. It could not depend on eating every scrap. She drew a saucepan and a separate bin beside the recipe, making both steps visible.

8The next basket was smaller. A pupil chose celery and liked its smell. Malik discarded an unclean stem. She wanted to add mayo to a cold dish and a piece of roasted cauliflower to the stew. Malik explained that one ingredient could have more than one use. A meal could help children learn moderation without making every food an indispensable part of a diet. Some preferred a bowl of ramen at home. He asked how pupils could dine on the same harvest without tossing useful stems. The pupil checked the basket before ordering more.

四级汇总词汇 · 44中文译文

用完一筐收成的一餐

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1学校食堂收到农场送来的一批收成。厨师马利克本来订的是土豆和一种主食谷物，货里还装着西葫芦、茄子、芹菜和几个熟桃子。农民说，因为个头太小，一家餐馆不肯收。马利克想做一份健康又让学生看得懂的菜单。助手提议把东西全打成酱。马利克请她从每个筐里拿一样尝尝。每种食材都用在合适的地方，这顿饭就能用上更多收成。

2他们决定做炖菜。马利克用料理机切碎芹菜，茄子则手工切。他先用橄榄油和盐把茄子煎出焦色，再下西葫芦。小火慢炖后，菜仍然软嫩。放一点芥末添味，又不会盖住蔬菜原本的味道。学生原以为只会有一盘普通沙拉，后来看到厨师能把味道收进酱汁，还能用上原本会被扔掉的叶、茎和果肉。

3谷物又是个单独的问题。一碗谷物粥常被剩下。有个学生嫌它发黏，另一个想多吃点水果。马利克加椰子煮了一小锅，拿其中一份拌进桃子。余下的放凉，用刷子抹油，再加热做成小饼。舀一勺香草酸奶，味道就不一样了。一名学生说，送来什么水果就配什么，芒果片或葡萄都行。

4一位员工建议用羊肉或海鲜。马利克保留了素食底料，虾用另一口锅，三文鱼用单独的烤盘。有学生问，剩牛排能不能加进同一锅肉汁。校医说，每一部分有什么都得写在标签上，光写热量还不够。冬天的菜单也可以有意面、咖喱或蘑菇菜。无论用什么配料，都要把准备和储存的办法说清楚。

5午餐时，炖菜最先卖完。学生问冬天还能不能做一回。马利克问农场，冬天哪些蔬菜多。种菜的人能供卷心菜、一点西兰花和一罐自制番茄酱。如果学校答应定期订货，他还可以再种一种菜。马利克想先定个灵活的办法。茄子不够，可以用另一种菜做同样的事，这样就不必等远处运货来。

6另一个班问，如果有一批货没送到，厨房怎么换食材。马利克做了一小份加罗勒的花菜。一个学生用打蛋器搅打一份浇料，加盐前先尝了一口。对年纪小的孩子来说，它有点苦。他们就换成淡一点的版本，试着包进饺子。厨师用这次试吃安排怎样让孩子们吃得有营养，也让大家有不同的选择。

7还剩两筐桃子。厨师用一部分做甜点，其余冷藏起来配酸奶。一个学生想用桃皮做装饰。马利克指给她看，发霉或脏了的那块为什么要扔掉。学校希望吃得更健康，也少浪费。有些边角确实不能吃。学生就在食谱旁画了一口锅和一个单独的垃圾桶，两步都能看明白。

8下一次的筐小一些。一个学生选了芹菜，喜欢它的味道。马利克丢掉一根不干净的茎。她想给凉菜加蛋黄酱，再把一块烤花菜放进炖菜里。马利克说，同一种食材可以有好几种做法。这顿饭能让孩子们学会适量地吃，也允许有人回家更喜欢吃碗拉面。他问，大家怎么能用同一批收成做饭，同时留下还能用的菜茎。学生这次先看了筐里剩下什么，再考虑要不要订新的。
